project_type: FastAPI Python service with async PostgreSQL persistence
build_system: setuptools with pyproject.toml, no build step needed for Python
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, test files in tests/ directory organized by category (unit/, integration/, agents/, etc.)
test_command: python -m pytest tests/unit/ -v (for unit tests), python -m pytest -v (for all tests)
verification_instructions: Run pytest on specific test files or directories to verify changes. Use python -m pytest tests/unit/test_auth_jwt.py -v for auth-specific tests.
environment_constraints: JWT_SECRET_KEY environment variable required (validated at startup in main.py). Database uses DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL. Service runs on port 8000.
contribution_requirements: All API endpoints that handle user data or perform privileged operations must use Depends(get_current_user) for authentication. Health and public snapshot endpoints may remain unauthenticated. Follow existing auth pattern in app/auth/dependencies.py.
key_patterns: FastAPI dependency injection via Depends(), async route handlers, existing auth tested with test fixtures in tests/conftest.py, existing RBAC roles (contract_admin, contract_reviewer, contract_viewer) for contract endpoints
directory_structure: services/project-ai/: app/ (application code with api/, auth/, models/, orchestration/, persistence/), tests/ (test files organized by type: unit/, integration/, agents/, certification/, evidence/, etc.), pyproject.toml (dependencies)
